title.ar: مين إنت من شخصيات باب الحارة؟
title.en: Which Bab Al-Hara character are you?

questions.ar: حدا قطع الدور عليك عالفرن. شو بتعمل؟
questions.en: Someone cuts in line at the bakery. What do you do?

options.ar: بحكي معه بهدوء وبفهّمه إنه في دور
options.en: Calmly explain there's a line
Step in front and send him to the back

options.ar: بسكت هلّق، بس كل الحارة رح تعرف بعدين
options.en: Stay quiet now, but the whole neighborhood will hear about it
Not worth it, I'll wait

questions.en: Your friends are fighting in the group chat. You?

options.en: Step in and make peace

options.ar: فوراً مع صاحبي، ظالم أو مظلوم
options.en: Instantly on my friend's side, right or wrong
Screenshot it and send it privately
Mute it and send a meme

questions.en: Your team lost a competition. Your reaction?

options.ar: ببارك للفريق التاني بكل روح رياضية
options.en: Congratulate the other team, good sport
I want a rematch. Now!
The referee was bought, and I won't forget it

options.ar: أصلاً حكيتلهم من الأول شو الغلط
options.en: I told them what they were doing wrong from the start

questions.en: In a group project, which one are you?

options.en: The one who leads and takes responsibility

options.ar: اللي بيعرف مين عامل شو، وأخبار الكل
options.en: The one who knows who's doing what, and everyone's news

options.ar: اللي بيعمل اللي بينطلب منه وبس
options.en: The one who does what they're told, nothing more

options.ar: اللي ما عاجبه الخطة وبيقولها بصوت عالي
options.en: The one who disagrees with the plan and says it out loud

questions.ar: حدا غلط عليك قدام الناس. شو بتعمل؟
questions.en: Someone insults you in front of people. What do you do?

options.en: Forgive, life's too short

options.ar: بردّ عليه فوراً وبكلمة وحدة بسكّته
options.en: Answer immediately, one sharp line shuts him up
Smile at him… and start planning

options.ar: بعليّ صوتي وبتصير حرب بين الحارتين
options.en: Raise my voice and it becomes a war between neighborhoods
I decide the plan for everyone
Visits, coffee and catching up on all the news
Sleep until the afternoon
A match with the guys, and we have to win

questions.en: Your friend told you a secret. With you, the secret is…

options.en: Buried forever, no matter what
Safe… mostly
Saved, for when I need it

options.ar: بأمان، بس رح أقوله رأيي فيه بصراحة
options.en: Safe, but I'll tell them honestly what I think about it

questions.ar: لو عندك قوة خارقة وحدة، بتكون؟
questions.en: If you had one superpower, it would be…

options.en: Wisdom, everyone comes to me for advice
Strength and courage
Everyone likes me
I can make anyone laugh
